examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodalaṭṭhiṃ dantehi mukh'ādhānaṃ vidhaṃsitvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
seyyathā'pi brāhmaṇa dakkho assadammako bhaddaṃ ass'ājānīyaṃ labhitvā paṭhamen'eva mukh'ādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāreti atha uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti

52798.meaning1: flexing the mouth; stretching the mouth
52798.commentary: (MNa) yāv'icchanti mukh'āyāmaṃ, yāva mukhaṃ pasāretuṃ icchanti, tāva pasāretvā bhāṇino, eko'pi saṅghagāravena mukhasaṅkocanaṃ na karotī'ti attho.

examples.text: parimuṭṭhā paṇḍit'ābhāsā, vācāgocarabhāṇino, yāv'icchanti mukh'āyāmaṃ, yena nītā na taṃ vidū.
yam'pi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti, tatra'p'ime mukh'āvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī'ti.
